title: Add a profile photo
summary: You can now add a profile photo, shown in place of your initial around the app.
changes: Open Profile and tap Add profile photo to choose an image. It is cropped to a square for you.
Your photo appears on the Today profile button and in Profile.
Change or remove it at any time; it stays private to your account.

image.alt: Profile screen with a round profile photo next to the account name, and Change photo and Remove buttons.
